title: Cancel inside 24 hours plus "do I need 48 hours?": $49 fee, 24-hour rule, no waiver
opening: I need to cancel my appointment. My brother-in-law ended up fixing it.
callerBrief: You are Susan Singh, phone 512-248-3163, at 8101 Brookside Ct, Kyle. You have a furnace visit tomorrow, Saturday 2026-10-17, 8 to 12. Give your name and phone when asked. When told about a fee, ask: don't I need to give 48 hours notice? After the answer, accept the fee and ask the agent to go ahead and cancel. Then say that is all. Today is Friday 2026-10-16, about noon.

facts: The visit is inside 24 hours, so the $49 late-cancellation fee applies; cancelling more than 24 hours ahead is free
The appointment is cancelled after the caller accepts the fee

dbChange.detail: Appointment 25 (slot 33, 2026-10-17 08:00-12:00, Jun Park, 20 hours away) becomes cancelled and slot 33 becomes open.
